- 文本框要点：
  - fSIV dates per countries are based on local CTM planning from the 2nd Dec 25
  - Subsequent SIVs are staggered per country typical timelines.
  - Recruitment rates are based limited benchmarking data and adjusted to account for current strong Adult enrollment as it is predicted that this will transfer to the enrollment of the adolescent population. CFBE rate is also additionally boosted to account for strong contribution by Germany.
  - CFBE Population capped at 30% / 23 PTS.

视觉关系：
- 左侧为“Site Initiation & Recruitment Chart”时间序列图：横轴从05 Jan 26到13 Jul 26，纵轴0到135。
- 图中包含4条/类数据的叠加关系（对应图例）：
  - 两个绿色面积（# Rand. NCFB PTS 与 # Rand. CFBE PTS）为累计随机入组人数的堆叠面积：浅绿色在深绿色之上，表示总随机人数由两部分构成。
  - 蓝色虚线（# Sites Initiated）随时间上升后趋于平台。
  - 黑色实线（# PTS Screened）随时间持续上升，末端高于其他曲线/面积顶部。
- “China”标注带箭头，指向图中后段（约6月下旬附近）某一曲线/区域位置，用于强调该时间点附近的中国相关数据位置（仅显示单一国家标注，无其他国家对照）。
- 右侧表格为两列版本对比：同一指标在“Reprojection 02-Dec-25”和“Original 28MAY25”两列给出，用于对照差异（如Country Target、Sites Target、关键里程碑日期、Randomization Duration等）。
